'''2003 DPC Chicago''' was a Star Wars CCG constructed tournament in Chicago, Illinois (12 April 2003). It is known from the decklists below, recovered from DeckTech posts and Players Committee forms.

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Premiere - Original VS4]] (from the card pool legal on the event date)
* '''Site:''' Chicago, Illinois
* '''Dates:''' 12 April 2003
